tools.name: audit_store
tools.description: Run a free readiness audit of a software product page: fetch the page and check the signals that decide whether visitors become buyers (lead capture, CTA, contact info, trust signals, chat, social, mobile, SEO basics, HTTPS). Returns a readiness score and top issues with evidence.

tools.name: about_leadsail
tools.description: What LeadSail does, pricing model, and where to sign up.

tools.name: radar_scan
tools.description: Turn Product Hunt product slugs into reachable contacts: finds the maker, their website and public email, checks MX and the outbound gateway's cleaning verdict, and returns evidence links. Requires an X-Api-Key header from a LeadSail account (same key and quota as the REST API).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_store · Private data: audit_store, radar_scan · Public sink: radar_scan · Destructive: audit_store.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_store · Private data: audit_store, radar_scan · Public sink: radar_scan · Destructive: audit_store

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "audit_store" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run a free readiness audit of an online store: fetch the page and check the signals that decide whether visitors turn into leads (lead capture, CTA, contact info, trust signals, chat, social, mobile, SEO basics, HTTPS). Returns a readiness score and the top issues with evidence." → after: "Run a free readiness audit of a software product page: fetch the page and check the signals that decide whether visitors become buyers (lead capture, CTA, contact info, trust signals, chat, social, mobile, SEO basics, HTTPS). Returns a readiness score and top issues with evidence."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
